videos.title: Space Shuttle Endeavour: Riding a 747 Over California
videos.hook_premise: A space shuttle cannot fly itself home, so a 747 carries Endeavour piggyback over California: where does the last ride end?

videos.title: Saturn V First Stage: Five F-1 Engines Held Down on a Test Stand
videos.hook_mechanism: Contrarian Question (benign: it wants to leave, it is held)
videos.hook_premise: Five F-1 engines, 7.5 million pounds of thrust, and a stage that wants to leave the ground: what holds it down while all five fire?

videos.title: Perseverance Sky Crane: A 1-Ton Rover Lowered on Cables
videos.hook_premise: A one-ton rover, no runway, no pad: the real onboard cameras show how Perseverance was set down on Mars.

videos.title: Space Shuttle Columbia STS-1: First Flight, No Crewless Test
videos.hook_premise: Two astronauts flew Columbia, a spacecraft that had never flown, with no crewless test flight: would it come home?

videos.title: X-15: The Rocket Plane a B-52 Dropped at 45,000 Feet
videos.hook_premise: A rocket plane can't take off from a runway at 45,000 ft: how do you launch it? Hang it under a B-52 and let go.

videos.title: Apollo Lunar Module: Why It Had No Shell
videos.hook_premise: Two men landed on the Moon in a lander with no smooth shell: why does the Moon lander look unfinished?

videos.title: Apollo Launch Escape System Tests: A Rocket on Top of the Capsule
videos.hook_premise: If the Moon rocket fails under three astronauts, what saves them? A small rocket on top of the capsule pulls it clear.

videos.title: SLS Core Stage: Chained Down, 1.6 Million Pounds of Thrust
videos.hook_premise: Four engines bolted to a test stand light together: can the Moon rocket's core stage burn the full 8 minutes? (1.6 million lb of thrust, chained down)

videos.title: Space Shuttle Boosters: Held by 62-Pound Bolts
videos.hook_mechanism: Number Gap (huge thrust vs small bolt)
videos.hook_premise: Two Space Shuttle boosters push 2.65 million pounds each. At ~2 minutes, what lets go of them? Steel bolts.
